description: Presents and grades exercises based on rendered HTML documents.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-html-viewer-question open="" src="/docs/components/markup-viewer-question/examples/emphasis.html" test="/docs/components/markup-viewer-question/examples/emphasis.test.js">
  <dl>
    <dt>Title</dt><dd>Semantic emphasis</dd>
    <dt>Prompt</dt><dd>Mark Hello with strong emphasis. Open Code to edit, then submit.</dd>
    <dt>Solution</dt><dd>Use the language's strong-emphasis syntax.</dd>
  </dl>
</tp-html-viewer-question>

attributes.name: ai-api
attributes.description: Allows sending AI prompts to the selected provider; without it, prompts are only copied.

attributes.name: ai-assistant
attributes.description: AI provider, optionally followed by /model; without a model, uses the server configuration. Providers: openai, anthropic, google, mistral.

attributes.name: ai-explanation-src
attributes.description: URL of a saved Markdown explanation; the companion .prompt.md must match the current prompt.

attributes.name: ai-help
attributes.description: Optional AI assistance; solution and both enable solution explanations. Feedback assistance is reserved for a future release.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Blank mode: opened, closed, or mixed local choices.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description:
Initial panels: both (also a bare attribute), input, or output. Absent or invalid values collapse the question.
 *   `detail: { value: unknown }`

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Displays the numerical score in submission feedback.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Markup source file loaded into the viewer; the concrete component selects its language.

attributes.name: test
attributes.description: Optional legacy test-file URL; a filename or link in Feedback takes precedence. Tests run against the submitted editor contents.

attributes.name: timing
attributes.description: Optional nonzero time limit in strict hh:mm:ss format.

methods.name: continueAfterTimeout(): void
methods.description: Reopens the question after its timer expires.

methods.name: explainSolution(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Opens the AI explanation for an unlocked solution when AI assistance is available.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Resets the response and clears the submitted feedback.

methods.name: setExerciseTiming(exercise: HTMLElement, pending: boolean): void
methods.description: Sets an enclosing exercise's solution gate without displaying a local timer.

methods.name: start(): void
methods.description: Starts the timed question when its Start action is available.

methods.name: submit(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Validates and submits the current response, respecting the same guards as Submit.

methods.name: toggleInput(): void
methods.description: Shows or hides the answer form, keeping at least one panel visible.

methods.name: toggleOutput(): void
methods.description: Shows or hides feedback, keeping at least one panel visible.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-html-viewer-question>` element presents and grades exercises based on rendered HTML documents.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Question title | Expand or collapse the exercise without losing code. |
| Input / Output | Show or hide the answer form or feedback panels. |
| Code / Render | Show or hide editable markup and its output. |
| Rendered HTML / Generated HTML / Tree, when available | Inspect the preview, generated HTML or parser structure. |
| Editor toolbar | Show or hide the source editor tools. |
| Run in the embedded toolbar | Refresh the preview from the edited markup without submitting. |
| Embedded Reset | Restore the original project. |
| Submit response | Run the external tests against the current code, including on repeated unchanged submissions. |
| Reset response | Restore the original code and cancel or clear the current report. |
| Feedback / Solution | Read test messages or the author's solution, available before submission. |
| Console controls | Copy or clear execution messages. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between question and programming controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused action or expand/collapse the title. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> in Output tabs | Navigate Feedback and Solution. |
| Typing in the editor | Modify source code using the embedded editor's editing behavior. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
